_note: bi-export-board. Board PqBiExport shows each job's last run (status, when, rows) and its next run, and filters on a failed last run. A job keeps those as fields of its own: ExportJobService::recordRun writes the last run's summary when a run finishes (ExportExecutionService), and nextRunAt is set when a job is enabled or after each run, null while it is disabled. The list reads and filters them like any field. Version 1.1.0 adds optional fields only. A run also records how many files it should write (fileCountExpected: one per dataset), so a partial run reads "2 van 3 bestanden".

lastRunStatus.title: Last run status
lastRunStatus.description: Status of the job's last finished run.

lastRunAt.title: Last run at
lastRunAt.description: When the job's last run ended, else when it began.

lastRunError.title: Last run error
lastRunError.description: Why the last run failed or stopped short, if it did.

nextRunAt.title: Next run at
nextRunAt.description: When the job runs next on its schedule; empty while it is disabled.

lastRunFilesExpected.title: Last run files expected
lastRunFilesExpected.description: Files the last run should have uploaded: one per dataset.

fileCountExpected.title: Files expected
fileCountExpected.description: Files the run should write: one per dataset of its job.
